channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: CAMPI, TMA report auto sales growth in June
item.description: THE CHAMBER of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI) and the Truck Manufacturers Association, Inc. (TMA) reported consolidated sales of 37,231 units in June, up 11% from 33,532 units in May 2026. The latest tally represents the industry’s highest monthly sales figure so far this

item.title: Suzuki grows dealer network nationwide
item.description: Suzuki Philippines is preparing a series of dealership relocations, relaunches and facility upgrades across Luzon, the Visayas and Metro Manila from July to September 2026.

item.title: Maxim launches tricycle, delivery services in Dumaguete
item.description: Maxim Rides & Food Delivery has started operating in Dumaguete City, where residents can now book tricycle rides, delivery trips and “pabili” requests through its mobile app.

item.title: ACMobility, Shell add 8 EV charging hubs
item.description: ACMobility and Shell Pilipinas Corporation have opened eight electric vehicle charging hubs at selected Shell Mobility stations, giving EV drivers more places to recharge outside Metro Manila.

item.title: Jetour T1 takes PHEV lead
item.description: The Jetour T1 Lightning i-DM led plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales in the Philippines during the first half of 2026, according to figures from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines Inc.

item.title: BMW Phl adds X3 30e xLine PHEV
item.description: BMW has expanded its local X3 plug-in hybrid range with the arrival of the X3 30e xDrive xLine, a new variant priced below the existing M Sport model.

item.title: VinFast Viper enters 125cc price range
item.description: VinFast is positioning the Viper as an electric alternative to the 125cc scooters that have long filled Philippine streets.

item.title: FIRST CLASS
item.description: Lexus Philippines joined Toyota Motor Philippines’ Road Trek for the first time and added three premium models to the annual media drive in Cebu.

item.title: The Velocity Q&A: Mark Berger (Product Manager for Neue Klasse BMW Group)
item.description: AS THE ELECTRIFICATION of mobility undeniably steps up in the Philippines, particularly with the US-Iran war causing spikes in fuel prices, car browsers are confronted with an increasing number of electrified choices from brands familiar and otherwise.

item.title: 3D-Printed Concrete Can Make Construction Climate-Friendly
item.description: An MIT team's first result is a model bridge that is 16% lighter than its traditionally made equivalent, with the same load capacity.

item.title: Changing Up Your Car's Interior? Here's How Much It Can Cost To Reupholster The Seats
item.description: Fixing up your car's interior can make a huge difference, but it can also cost a fortune. Here's what to know about the true costs of professional reupholstery.

item.title: Test: 2001 Qvale Mangusta Is a Head-Turner and a Head-Scratcher
item.description: Owners will have some explaining to do.
